topics.title: FastAPI dependency injection
facts: `Depends()` lets FastAPI resolve and cache a dependency once per request.
Dependencies with `yield` run teardown code after the response is sent, which is ideal for DB sessions.
Sub-dependencies compose, so auth can depend on a DB session that depends on settings.

topics.title: FastAPI background tasks
facts: `BackgroundTasks` runs work after the response is returned, in the same process.
It suits small jobs like sending an email; long jobs belong in a real queue.
An exception in a background task does not change the already-sent response.

topics.title: Pydantic v2 validators
facts: `field_validator` replaces v1's `validator` and must be a classmethod.
`model_validator(mode="after")` sees the fully built model for cross-field checks.
`model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` is the clean way to build PATCH updates.

topics.title: RAG chunking strategies
facts: Fixed-size chunks with 10-20% overlap are a strong, cheap baseline.
Splitting on document structure (headings, paragraphs) keeps chunks semantically whole.
Chunk size trades recall against precision: small chunks match narrowly, large ones dilute embeddings.

topics.title: Hybrid search for RAG
facts: Dense embeddings catch meaning; BM25 catches exact terms like error codes and names.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion merges ranked lists without needing comparable scores.
A reranker on the top 20-50 candidates often beats tuning the retriever further.

topics.title: Evaluating RAG pipelines
facts: Measure retrieval (did the right chunk appear?) separately from generation (was the answer faithful?).
A small hand-labelled set of 30-50 questions catches most regressions.
Faithfulness checks ask whether every claim in the answer is supported by retrieved context.
topics.snippet:
def recall_at_k(retrieved, relevant, k=5):
    return len(set(retrieved[:k]) & set(relevant)) / max(len(relevant), 1)

topics.title: Prompt engineering: structured output
facts: Asking for JSON plus giving a schema sharply reduces parsing failures.
Few-shot examples steer format more reliably than long instructions.
Always validate model output; treat it as untrusted input.
topics.snippet:
data = json.loads(reply)
result = ReviewResult.model_validate(data)  # reject anything off-schema

topics.title: LLM tool calling
facts: The model only proposes a tool call; your code decides whether to execute it.
Clear tool names and argument descriptions matter more than the system prompt.
Return compact, structured tool results to save context tokens.

topics.title: Agent loops and stop conditions
facts: Every agent loop needs a hard iteration cap, not just a 'done' signal.
Feeding errors back as observations lets the model self-correct.
Logging each step's input and output makes agent bugs debuggable.

topics.title: React useEffect cleanup
facts: The function returned from `useEffect` runs before the next effect and on unmount.
StrictMode runs effects twice in dev to expose missing cleanup.
An `AbortController` cleanly cancels a stale fetch.

topics.title: React useMemo vs useCallback
facts: `useMemo` caches a computed value; `useCallback` caches a function identity.
Both only help when the stable reference is consumed, e.g. by `React.memo` or an effect dependency.
Premature memoization adds cost; profile first.
topics.snippet:
const sorted = useMemo(() => [...items].sort(byDate), [items]);
const onSelect = useCallback(id => setSelected(id), []);

topics.title: Custom React hooks
facts: A custom hook is just a function whose name starts with `use` and calls other hooks.
Hooks share logic, not state: each caller gets its own state.
Return a small, stable API (value plus setters) from the hook.

topics.title: Git interactive staging
facts: `git add -p` stages individual hunks so one commit holds one idea.
`git commit --fixup <sha>` plus `rebase --autosquash` tidies history.
`git restore --staged` unstages without touching the working tree.
topics.snippet:
git commit --fixup a1b2c3d
git rebase -i --autosquash main

topics.title: Git bisect
facts: `git bisect` binary-searches history to find the commit that introduced a bug.
`git bisect run <cmd>` automates it with any script that exits non-zero on failure.
Finding a bug among 1000 commits takes about 10 steps.
topics.snippet:
git bisect start HEAD v1.0
git bisect run pytest tests/test_login.py
git bisect reset

topics.title: Git worktrees
facts: `git worktree add` checks out another branch in a separate folder sharing one repo.
It avoids stashing when you need to hotfix while mid-feature.
Remove with `git worktree remove` to keep metadata clean.
topics.snippet:
git worktree add ../hotfix release/1.2
cd ../hotfix && git commit -am "fix"
git worktree remove ../hotfix

topics.title: System design: caching
facts: Cache-aside: read the cache, on miss load from DB and populate.
Every cache needs an invalidation story; TTLs are the simplest one.
Watch for thundering herds when a hot key expires; add jitter or locks.

topics.title: System design: rate limiting
facts: Token bucket allows bursts while enforcing an average rate.
Sliding-window counters are more accurate than fixed windows at boundaries.
Return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header so clients back off.
topics.snippet:
def allow(bucket, now, rate=5, cap=10):
    bucket.tokens = min(cap, bucket.tokens + (now - bucket.ts) * rate)
    bucket.ts = now
    if bucket.tokens >= 1:
        bucket.tokens -= 1
        return True
    return False

topics.title: System design: idempotency keys
facts: Clients send a unique key so retried POSTs do not create duplicates.
The server stores the key with the first response and replays it on retries.
Keys need an expiry window, commonly 24 hours.
topics.snippet:
if (saved := store.get(idem_key)):
    return saved
resp = create_payment(body)
store.set(idem_key, resp, ttl=86400)
return resp

topics.title: Jetpack Compose state hoisting
facts: Hoist state up so composables become stateless and easy to preview and test.
`remember` survives recomposition; `rememberSaveable` also survives configuration changes.
Pass state down and events up: value plus onValueChange.

topics.title: Compose side effects
facts: `LaunchedEffect(key)` runs a coroutine tied to composition and restarts when the key changes.
`DisposableEffect` is for register/unregister pairs like listeners.
`rememberCoroutineScope` launches coroutines from event handlers.

topics.title: Kotlin coroutines and Flow
facts: `viewModelScope` cancels coroutines automatically when the ViewModel clears.
`StateFlow` always has a value and suits UI state.
`collectAsStateWithLifecycle` stops collecting when the UI is in the background.

topics.title: Security basics: password hashing
facts: Never store plain or fast-hashed (MD5/SHA) passwords; use bcrypt, scrypt or Argon2.
These algorithms are deliberately slow and salted per password.
Compare secrets with constant-time functions to avoid timing leaks.
topics.snippet:
import hmac
hmac.compare_digest(given_token, expected_token)

topics.title: Security basics: SQL injection
facts: Parameterized queries keep data separate from SQL code.
ORMs are safe by default but raw string formatting reintroduces risk.
Least-privilege DB users limit the blast radius of any injection.
topics.snippet: cur.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = %s", (email,))  # never f-strings

topics.title: Security basics: JWT pitfalls
facts: Always pin the expected algorithm when verifying a JWT.
Keep access tokens short-lived and rotate refresh tokens.
JWT payloads are only encoded, not encrypted; never put secrets in them.
topics.snippet: claims = jwt.decode(token, SECRET, algorithms=["HS256"])

topics.title: DSA pattern: sliding window
facts: Sliding window turns many O(n^2) substring problems into O(n).
Expand the right edge, shrink the left while the window is invalid.
A hashmap of counts tracks window contents.

topics.title: DSA pattern: two pointers
facts: Two pointers on a sorted array solve pair-sum problems in O(n).
Fast/slow pointers detect cycles in linked lists.
Moving the pointer with the worse value is the usual greedy step.

topics.title: DSA pattern: binary search on answer
facts: If feasibility is monotonic in the answer, binary search the answer itself.
Write a `feasible(x)` check and search the smallest x that passes.
Classic uses: shipping capacity, minimum speed, split array.
topics.snippet:
lo, hi = 1, max(piles)
while lo < hi:
    mid = (lo + hi) // 2
    lo, hi = (lo, mid) if feasible(mid) else (mid + 1, hi)

topics.title: Python asyncio gather and timeouts
facts: `asyncio.gather` runs awaitables concurrently and returns results in order.
`asyncio.timeout()` (3.11+) bounds any block of awaits.
`TaskGroup` cancels sibling tasks if one fails.
topics.snippet:
async with asyncio.timeout(5):
    async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as tg:
        a = tg.create_task(fetch(u1))
        b = tg.create_task(fetch(u2))

topics.title: pytest fixtures
facts: Fixtures provide setup via function arguments, not inheritance.
`yield` fixtures handle teardown; scope controls reuse.
`tmp_path` and `monkeypatch` are built-in fixtures worth knowing.

topics.title: GitHub Actions caching
facts: `setup-python` and `setup-node` have built-in dependency caching via `cache:`.
Cache keys should hash lockfiles so caches invalidate on dependency changes.
Run cheap checks (lint) before slow ones (E2E) to fail fast.
topics.snippet:
- uses: actions/setup-python@v5
  with:
    python-version: "3.12"
    cache: pip

topics.title: Docker multi-stage builds
facts: Build in one stage, copy only artifacts into a slim runtime stage.
Order layers from least to most frequently changed to maximize cache hits.
Run as a non-root user in the final image.
topics.snippet:
FROM node:20 AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm ci && npm run build

FROM nginx:alpine
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html

topics.title: Automation with Python scripts
facts: `pathlib` makes file automation readable and cross-platform.
`argparse` gives any script a proper CLI with help text for free.
Make scripts idempotent so re-running them is always safe.
topics.snippet:
for p in Path("downloads").glob("*.pdf"):
    p.rename(Path("docs") / p.name)

topics.title: HTTP caching headers
facts: `Cache-Control: max-age` lets browsers skip requests entirely.
`ETag` with `If-None-Match` enables cheap 304 revalidation.
Hashed asset filenames allow `immutable` long-term caching.
topics.snippet:
Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable
ETag: "a1b2c3"

topics.title: Embeddings and cosine similarity
facts: Cosine similarity compares direction, ignoring vector length.
Normalizing vectors once makes cosine equal to a plain dot product.
Use the same embedding model for queries and documents.
